item: Reports, field data and log lines mask every query value but a reviewed harmless one (R734)
key_paths: src/database/address_mask.py src/ingest/fetch_verdict.py src/database/feed_key.py src/api/diagnostics/source_samples.py src/analytics/engine_identity.py tests/test_address_mask_r734.py
summary: A feed or source address written to a report, a field data file, a diagnostics bundle or a log line kept its query string, so a token in a feed address (?token=, ?key=) left the machine in a file the operator sends back. One helper now writes it with the userinfo masked, every query value masked except a reviewed allowlist of harmless parameter names (format, lang, page, sort, category and the like, value checked against a narrow pattern), and the fragment dropped. Fail closed: an odd name or value is masked. Stable masking (no salt), so two instances' rows still join. The UI's own answers keep the R637 form, because an edit form sends the shown address back. Exception text is scrubbed of the masked values too. Ratchets: only UI answer modules use shown_url, no scrub call takes userinfo only, no report row or log line writes an address raw.
